new_findings.problem: One irreversible action, two verbs in one flow: the confirm asks हटाएँ (remove) and the receipt now says मिटाया गया (erased). Before d4e31b1 both said हटाया/हटाएँ, so the split is a consequence of the fix. Core's own committed Hindi splits the same way and makes the confirmation the odd one: wire.slash.delete renders a permanent delete as 'इस बातचीत को हमेशा के लिए मिटाएँ; पुष्टि माँगता है', while हटाएँ is the dismiss/remove verb (tui.notifications.hint_dismiss, hint_clear). हटाएँ here is also the verb the milestone remove uses (remove_milestone_body), which is the removed/deleted collapse HI-B-10 set out to break.
